text: Hallelu YAH! Blessed [is] the man fearing YHWH; in His commandments he has delighted greatly.
His seed is mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
Wealth and riches [are] in his house, and his righteousness stands forever.
Light has risen in the darkness for the upright—[for] the gracious, and compassionate, and righteous.
The good man is gracious and lends freely; he contains his affairs with justice.
Surely he will not be shaken forever; the righteous will be as a memorial forever.
Of an evil report he is not afraid; his heart is firm, trusting in YHWH.
His heart is upheld; he will not be afraid, until that he looks on his enemies.
He has scattered—he has given to the needy; his righteousness stands forever; his horn is raised high in honor.
A wicked one will see and be angry; he will gnash his teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked ones will perish.
